newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev ends flat, unmoved by vote results.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev ends flat, unmoved by vote results.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 240.00/50 per dollar, unchanged from opening levels and unmoved by results of Sunday's presidential elections after a very thin trade, dealers said.
"Very light (foreign currency) volumes traded today as demand and supply were balanced," a commercial bank dealer said.
The central bank was seen offering low dollar volumes to final clients around 240 levs, traders said.
Preliminary results of Bulgaria's first round of presidential elections had had no immediate impact on the market, traders said.
"(The lev/dollar) exchange rate here depends much more on central bank decisions than on political events like elections," another dealer said.

Preliminary official results gave the main opposition candidate Petar Stoyanov a comfortable lead of 43.65 percent of the vote over the governing Socialists' contender Ivan Marazov, who had 27.07 percent. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
